description: Reconstruct a calendar (cron-style) schedule from its portable JSON form. The decoder reads the five field expressions and rebuilds the schedule, preserving each original expression. The output reports the reconstructed minute, hour, day-of-week, day-of-month and month-of-year expressions.

cases.expected_output:
type=crontab
minute=*
hour=*
day_of_week=*
day_of_month=*
month_of_year=*
